facts.fact: Corrects F863: Sanu (Fourth Guard) is male; his birth name Chandrika, given after his mother's mother, is on his intake roll as a tailor's son of Pallikara, sold at seven.
Corrects F865: Usha's crown-leaf ledger number is Nineteen, not Four (Four is Thilak's, F632).

Neela half-notices that Chathu's grey-brown common-ink fingertips (F838) and his unanswered steward's list (F837) do not fit the forty black-ink pages the queen says he wrote at her table. She fails to resolve it under the queen's calm (clue C03/C17 stays live).
